entities.summary: Neak Pean at Angkor, Cambodia is an artificial island with a Mahayana Buddhist temple on a circular island in Jayatataka Baray, which was associated with Preah Khan temple, built during the reign of King Jayavarman VII. It is the "Mebon" of the Preah Khan baray. Neak Pean is a archaeological site from Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
